\[
u\cdot v=(2a+b)\cdot(-3a+2b)
=-6(a\cdot a)+4(a\cdot b)-3(b\cdot a)+2(b\cdot b)
\]
\[
=-6+4\cdot\frac12-3\cdot\frac12+2=-\frac72
\]

\[
\|u\|^2=(2a+b)\cdot(2a+b)=4+1+4\cdot\frac12=7
\]
\[
\|v\|^2=(-3a+2b)\cdot(-3a+2b)=9+4-12\cdot\frac12=7
\]

Thus
\[
\cos\theta=\frac{u\cdot v}{\|u\|\|v\|}
=\frac{-\frac72}{\sqrt7\sqrt7}=-\frac12
\]
So
\[
\theta=120^\circ
\]

\boxed{120}
